task: Investigate and fix why SDLC Factory sessions from most developers are missing from CLI analytics (EPMCDME-16441), recording root causes and fixing product defects.

key_reasoning.reason: Four candidate causes span the claude-code-otlp plugin (SessionEnd, SubagentStop, allowlist), project resolution (identity fields, session pin) and the SSO proxy otlp-spool (project gate, completeness gate, forwarder), plus the legacy hook command.

The ticket is an investigation: root causes are unknown, evidence lives in production data and developer machines outside the repo, and the fixes are not yet defined. Several design decisions are open.

No exact precedent for the headless claude -p end-of-session loss or the subagent cost roll-up. The closest pattern is the existing per-event handler and content-hashed resend design, which does not cover short-lived hook kill timing. The project gate drops data irreversibly, and multi-process timing is subtle. Existing tests do not cover headless or subagent roll-up paths.

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk held at L: gating logic and irreversible drops, with no test template for headless termination or subagent cost roll-up
